name: langford_n15__v3_h
prompt:
Construct a Langford sequence L(2,15): a sequence of length 30 containing exactly 2 copies of each integer from 1 to 15, such that the two occurrences of each value v are exactly v+1 positions apart (so copies of 1 are 1 position apart, copies of 2 are 2 positions apart, etc.). Example: L(2,3) has solution [2, 3, 1, 2, 1, 3].

Return seq as a list of 30 integers in 1..15, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no such sequence exists.

Partial assignment (fixed values that must be respected):
- seq[3]=2, seq[11]=14, seq[13]=11, seq[26]=14, seq[27]=7, seq[28]=10
Return a complete solution consistent with these fixed assignments.
